finding: Keeping native D proposals restored five known R170 reference coverage losses and yielded 18/32 versus 13/32 coverage on new physical frames. Final dual identity was 2/32 for both native joint and its no-left control on new frames. Acc@50 was 1.389 pp lower.
decision: Retain the unrestricted native reference readout as a coverage diagnostic and ablation. Keep R158 plus PCA as the deployed readout and withhold a reliable joint-binding claim.
